folds.heading: ## Lazy-body reconciliation B126, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full LEVELS/TRIGGERS/CONSISTENCY/BUDGET/REPORT read, preserving L/T/C/B and GN1–GN12/BD1–BD9/AT/AC cases. Demand bundles are simulation working sets, not relationship ranks or disclosure permission. A hidden job can require private body truth without introducing an NPC; friends receive only actual evidence. Explicit resolved-none coverage differs from an unmaterialized empty collection. Stable person/body/instance identity and typed descent/adoption/teaching/office matter more than matching labels. Parent/child latent anchors and event-time capsules preserve earlier constraints; their specification does not implement a joint solver. Unknown prehistory stays unknown, and contradictions stop the selected operation without inventing a parent or rerolling prior truth. Observer learning stage, confidence and actual support remain distinct.

Current source qualifies F3/M2’s historical branch-only/exactly-three traveler statements: main imports generatedPeople and serializes its snapshot; generated_people supports revision-aware3–5 travelers with origin requirements for the larger set. That is neither broad population support nor generated body/genetics proof. Existing streams are integrated as inspected in B111/B114; body demand must not reuse name/personality cursors. Old USER_VISION2055–2068/2080–2082 locators have moved; actual body-age/adult-appearance direction was read at2504–2538. Keep its meaning rather than relying on unrelated text now at old lines.

Recomputed B8–B15 row/evidence/base64/lineage arithmetic matches every displayed value. These are ASCII planning allowances, not measured records. B1–B4 are total row sizes; lineage snapshots cost bytes even while phenotype is lazy. Current save_files counts complete shared-origin UTF-16 size, keys/other-key overhead and a4MiB guard separately from browser quota. No automatic10k fit, codec speed, Unicode encoding identity, save throughput or memory proof follows. Targets cannot justify deleting fixed truth, claims/custody or creation history and are not valid-save rejection limits. Reserve settlement capacity for selected work; file export does not enlarge browser storage.

Current [PROJECT](../../../../../PROJECT.md), AD42 and AD51 in [RULES_INDEX](../../../../RULES_INDEX.md) govern retired milestone, optional human review and shared-seam design. Authored one-person operations can remain narrow; no demand to build every NPC or parent graph before another selected slice. Migration/model/schema/capsule/observer/native gates remain specified, not performed here. No runtime schema, storage backend, population admission, private save or gameplay operation changed.
